description: This Java class, OutputContentFile, extends StaticContentFile and implements Serializable. It is responsible for carrying static content data from the cache to the service layer, encapsulating a ByteArrayOutputStream as its data payload.

classes.name: OutputContentFile
classes.description: A data class that holds static content data transfer object, extending StaticContentFile and Serializable, encapsulating a ByteArrayOutputStream.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Getter method that returns the ByteArrayOutputStream containing the file data.

methods.name: setFile
methods.description: Setter method that assigns a ByteArrayOutputStream to the file field.
